entries.zh: 米粿：米制糕饼，闽南节庆米食（做粿）；一说排成串行（西语 retahila 义存疑）
entries.en: rice cake (steamed rice-flour cake); to make rice cakes; arr. to line up in a row (retahila, uncertain)
entries.notes: 西语 retahila（串、列）与未展开缩写 ca. 同「粿」字面义衔接不明，释义以汉字与读音为主。

entries.zh: 叠：把东西堆叠摞起；折叠收拾
entries.en: to pile up, stack; to fold, put in order

entries.zh: 安静：安静、平静；使安静、平息（下人之喧扰）
entries.en: quiet, calm, tranquil; to quiet down, to still (the clamor of inferiors)
entries.notes: 首字有[疑:遏/过]，依读音 ān/ār 与「静」字判读为「安静」。

entries.zh: 遏杀：压制、遏止；扼杀（指压服制止下人之言）
entries.en: to suppress, put a stop to; to crush
entries.notes: 首字[疑:遏/过]，官话对音 fā 与「杀」对应欠明，义据西语与上条同款语境推定。

entries.zh: 结彩：结扎彩绸彩带（为牌坊、彩台结彩庆贺）
entries.en: to festoon with colored silk; to deck arches and festival platforms with streamers

entries.zh: 结彩亭：搭扎结彩的亭棚彩楼（庆典彩台、迎赛彩亭）
entries.en: to build and deck a festooned pavilion or canopy-stage for celebrations

entries.zh: 排齐整：排列整齐、收拾齐整
entries.en: to arrange in order; to set things in a neat row

entries.zh: 祭文：祭奠亡人的悼文（祭时宣读之文）
entries.en: funeral eulogy; sacrificial text read for the dead

entries.zh: 祝文：祭祝告神之文（历数亡者生平事迹的祭告文）
entries.en: sacrificial prayer text; eulogy rehearsing the deeds of the deceased

entries.zh: 整起衣：整理衣裳、穿戴齐整
entries.en: to arrange and put on one's clothes; to dress, tidy one's clothing

entries.zh: 与人和好：相与和好、相处融洽
entries.en: to be on good terms with them; to get along well
entries.notes: 第二字[疑:省/首]，西语句尾「&」截断；释义据西语「与之相善」与「好」字推定。

entries.zh: 制药料：配药制药、调制药材
entries.en: to compound and prepare medicines, medicinal ingredients

entries.zh: 相处：与人相处、打交道；相与办理事务交易
entries.en: to get along with; to deal with, conduct any business or transaction

entries.zh: 说合：从中说合、撮合两方成事（居间调停）
entries.en: to mediate between parties, to bring about an agreement; go-between, match-making
entries.notes: 西语后附拉丁化闽南语 Secaucngan 未能解读，不影响本条释义。

entries.zh: 叠起：把东西叠起来、层层堆叠
entries.en: to pile up, stack one thing upon another

entries.zh: 时文：时下之文（应时应制的文章，科举时文）
entries.en: composition of the times; contemporary essay, examination-style prose

entries.zh: 面貌：面貌、相貌（外表容颜）
